title: Karnataka is bringing AI into government schools from Class 6
source_used: Education Times and India Today (YourStory blocked, 403)
key_facts: Karnataka plans to extend AI training in government schools down to Class 6; it currently exists for Class 9 (Education Times).
Officials were directed to find a way to do this with the state IT department.
Google has expressed interest in helping; officials were told to study its work in Telangana.
Officials were also told to identify land for a dedicated AI university.
The state is recruiting 956 teachers on an outsourcing basis.
India Today calls it a proposed course and says details of curriculum and timetable are still to come.
The two outlets name different officials as the source of the announcement.
quote_evidence: In Karnataka, AI training currently exists for Class 9 students in government schools.
Officials have been asked to study how Google has already implemented similar initiatives in Telangana, to understand what could work well if adapted for Karnataka.
why_it_matters_hint: A state government plans to teach AI to younger pupils, with details not yet set.
notes: Original YourStory page blocked. Education Times attributes the directions to 'Shivakumar'; India Today credits Chief Minister Siddaramaiah. Summary names neither.
